# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 preview updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154. It also aligns HarfBuzzSharp binding generation with the native source pinned by the bundled Skia build.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed** — Use `UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132` instead of `CCC133`. The numeric value remains 132, but the managed name now matches corrected upstream HarfBuzz naming.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined was removed** — Combine the concrete `GlyphFlags` values your code needs instead of using the aggregate `GlyphFlags.Defined` mask.

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia m154** — Moves the bundled graphics engine to Chrome milestone 154. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 4, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the m154 line with the bundled engine update and synchronized HarfBuzzSharp generation.
